verdict.rationale: OpenClaw runs as a self-hosted Gateway process with no UI required. It can be deployed in Docker as a throwaway environment and supports headless nodes. It also exposes programmatic HTTP surfaces (an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint, direct tool invocation, and webhooks that let external services wake an agent or submit a turn), plus a built-in persistent scheduler and an official CLI. Together these clearly support unattended, automated operation. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline documentation (e.g. GitHub Actions or non-interactive/one-shot run mode, exit codes), a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
